purpose: Shift AI Core EVID from governance-heavy evidence plumbing toward explicit measurement of whether a strategy produces decision-relevant, robust, executable value.

problem_elimination.goal: Measure strategy validity without creating another chain of gates before the research inputs are authorized.
delete: No new receipt-on-receipt governance chain for ordinary evaluator outputs.
No arbitrary PASS thresholds in the foundation layer.
No duplicate outcome access path around existing authorization gates.
reuse: Existing timestamp/vintage/provenance/dedup/OOS isolation remain hard integrity constraints.
Existing V2.8.12 prospective E-layer accumulation remains independent and unchanged.

metric_contract.regime: Report the same core return statistics per supplied regime label; do not infer market regimes in this layer.
metric_contract.calibration: When predicted_probability and realized_positive are present, report count, mean predicted probability, realized positive rate and Brier score. No calibration binning or pass threshold is imposed in V2.9 foundation.
metric_contract.sensitivity: When parameter_variant is present, report metrics by variant. Foundation does not rank or select a winning parameter set.
metric_contract.concentration: When security_id is present, report unique security count and maximum observation share from one security.
metric_contract.drawdown: Not computed from unordered event observations. A later portfolio-path evaluator must require an explicitly defined chronological portfolio return series rather than silently assume equal weighting.

hard_integrity_boundary: No future leakage or outcome contamination.
No silent classifier or threshold change.
No timestamp ambiguity that can alter inference.
No sample identity ambiguity that can alter inference.
explicit_non_goals: Does not authorize current V2.8.12 E-event outcome resolution.
Does not convert diagnostic metrics into a hard gate without a separately reviewed threshold contract.
